context_requirements: Functional IGF1R expression and intact IGF-1/IGF1R autocrine or paracrine signalling
Dependence on PI3K-AKT and/or MAPK-ERK signalling for proliferation and survival
Presence of IGF-1 or IGF-2 ligand in the culture environment or autocrine production
Intact downstream signalling components (IRS-1/2, PI3K, AKT, ERK) for pathway inhibition to be detectable
falsifiers: No decrease in proliferation-associated landmark genes (e.g., CCND1, MYC, PCNA, MCM3) at 24 h in any responsive line
No increase in FOXO target genes (e.g., IGFBP3, DDIT4, TSC22D3, CDKN1A) at 6 or 24 h
Strong and uniform transcriptional responses across all nine lines, including HA1E, which lacks a clear IGF-1-driven phenotype
Predominant upregulation of cell-cycle genes rather than downregulation at 24 h
No difference between 6 h and 24 h responses, contradicting the expected slow kinetics

evidence.supports: IGF-1R inhibitor tyrphostin AG 1024 inhibits proliferation and induces apoptosis in MCF-7 breast cancer cells, with downregulation of phospho-Akt1 and increased p53/p21
IGF-1/TXNIP axis promotes malignancy and endocrine resistance in ER-positive breast cancer, supporting IGF-1 pathway dependence in MCF-7
ATM regulates IGF-1 expression, linking IGF-1 to senescence and DNA damage response pathways
IGF-1 inhibitor picropodophyllotoxin suppresses IGF-1 protein and modulates apoptosis in a myocardial infarction model
